summary:
Frank is on top of him, and he looks terrifying. Blood and pieces of something - no, someone - are smeared in his hair, and his eyes are too big, his pupils blown wide.
“Frank?” Peter’s voice cracks.
Frank blinks and the terror on his face is replaced with fury. “You little shit,” he sneers. “You take a hit for me again, and I’m going to beat your ass!”
...
Peter and Frank weren’t fast friends. No, this is a relationship years in the making.
